sections.heading: Summary
paragraphs: The file proposes removing the ExtendProgram (per the file) instruction from Loader V3. Per the file, with [SIMD-0433], the Upgrade (per the file) instruction resizes the programdata acct to match the ELF being (per the file) deployed, so extension as a (per the file) separate step no longer serves a purpose. Per the file, after activation, ExtendProgram MUST fail.

sections.heading: Motivation

Per the file, this makes ExtendProgram redundant (per the file) for its original purpose.

sections.heading: Program-Owned Upgrade Authorities
paragraphs: Per the file, programs with a program-owned (per the file) upgrade authority that need to (per the file) grow by more than 10 (per the file) KiB in one upgrade must (per the file) implement the authority hand-off described below. Per the file, the workflow is a single tx, signed by the designated (per the file) "hot" keypair that serves (per the file) as the upgrade's top-level (per the file) signer, with the following instructions: A CPI from the owning program (per the file) to Loader V3's SetAuthority to assign (per the file) the hot keypair as the new upgrade (per the file) authority, signed by the PDA authority.

Per the file, a top-level Loader V3 (per the file) Upgrade instruction to perform the (per the file) upgrade and resize the programdata acct by more than 10 KiB. Per the file, this is authorized at (per the file) the top level by (per the file) the signing hot keypair. Per the file, a top-level Loader V3 (per the file) SetAuthority instruction to reassign the (per the file) original PDA authority as the (per the file) upgrade authority, as it was (per the file) at the beginning.

Per the file, programs may also choose (per the file) to employ one or (per the file) more "guard" instructions that (per the file) assert that the resulting (per the file) upgrade authority at the end of the tx is in fact the correct address. Per the file, this new workflow leverages tx atomicity to perform a (per the file) safe upgrade when the programdata acct has to be resized by more than 10 KiB.
